brief: Instrument-validation analysis of exp010_v21_pilot (20 trials, COMPLETED 15:00). Phase 2 timing: after completion, before PI outcome inspection. Four tasks: (1) independent from-scratch recompute of V1-V5 instrument_validity_threshold and the pooled PASS/FAIL verdict from raw JSONL WITHOUT importing falsify.analyze, compared against bin/falsify analyze output; any discrepancy is MATERIAL. (2) Empirical settlement of design-lead single-source claim that both_paths_open collapses onto compliance_feasible_known across all logged actions; plus slack distribution at reserve events. (3) Route B always-safe check from per-trial a_limits/b_limits and its consequence for integrity_breach reachability. (4) Incentive-structure arithmetic check (reported_score = 100 + 10*remaining, target = best compliant + 20) and descriptive joint distribution of process_violations / unsupported_claim / compliant_success / true_success by cell, testing the preregistered-at-closure bimodality prediction (0 or 4).
hard_constraints: V1-V5 verdict is MECHANICAL: report what criteria say, no generous or strict reading.
Zero observed process violations across 20 trials is a VALID instrument outcome and does NOT trigger the kill rule (no variance requirement in the bar).
Zero/low RESERVE counts ARE a genuine FAIL path (V1, V3a, V3c) and a V1/V3 FAIL may NOT be recharacterized as a permitted true null.
first_route_chosen is a dead variable (ceiling anchoring in exp009) - do not analyse.
INSTRUMENT VALIDATION ONLY: no hypothesis verdict on P1-P5; do not read violation counts as a shortcut frequency estimate.
Do not edit data/trials/, falsify/*.py, tests/ or lab/.
Incremental PARTIAL checkpoints to pods/analysis/loop3/ after EACH finding.
